title: BAI to Host Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is organizing a crucial advanced coaching course in two Indian cities to develop local talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) will conduct a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026, aiming to enhance coaching standards across the country.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern one of India's key domestic team championships, impacting state-level competition and player pathways.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly affects the composition of India's potential women's doubles representation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An official notification has been issued regarding a change in a women's doubles pair slated for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's promising young talent for significant continental junior championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System in Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant change in scoring format will directly impact how young Indian players compete and develop in national events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
